headline: Sleep debt is driving today's red call — the morning's Un1t class already spent some of the recovery budget, so the rest of today is about paying that debt back, not training more.
body_state: Readiness composite 40.8 (moderate band, red verdict) — sleep is the dominant driver: 5.4h last night, 11% deep sleep (13-23% is restorative), and 26h of 14-day sleep debt. Body battery 33, overnight recharge only +31 (vs 43-50 the last two mornings). Resting HR 53 vs your 49.6 baseline — flagged `rhr_elevated`, and paired with the sleep debt the overtraining composite reads `caution`. HRV 41, still BALANCED. TSB -16.8 sits inside the -5 to -30 productive-training band, so the fitness is landing fine; the body just hasn't recovered from it yet.
session: This morning's Un1t class is already logged: 41 min, avg HR 133, 62% of it in zone 3/4, TE aerobic 2.7 / anaerobic 2.6 — a real hybrid stimulus, not a light one, on a morning the readiness read explicitly called for easy. It's done, can't be undone, so the move now is to protect the rest of today: no more training, earlier bed tonight (~60 min, per the insights action), and treat tomorrow's 7km easy run as genuinely easy — zone-2 capped, not just 'not a workout'.
recent: Yesterday's 4km tempo came in at 78% of planned volume (yellow) — HR topped out at 156, well under your 163 threshold, despite an RPE 8. That's the same hard-feeling-but-not-actually-hard pattern flagged after last week's crash: legs are flat, not fit. Aug 11 stacked an Un1t class with a 32km bike ride; Aug 10's easy run was clean (EF 1.53, on trend). The through-line across the block is cross-training crowding out true easy days — intensity distribution sits at 22% easy against an 80% target, and today added to that rather than correcting it.
focus: Protect sleep tonight — bedtime 60 min earlier is the actual lever on 26h of debt, not a training change.
Tomorrow's 7km easy run: cap HR at zone-2, no exceptions — the last two 'easy' efforts weren't.
Watch resting HR over the next 2-3 mornings; if it stays above ~52, drop the next quality session (Aug 17 speed reps) rather than push through.
